intro: Select the opening that suits your room
options: Casement & fixed windows
Combine opening panels for ventilation with fixed glazing where you want an uninterrupted view.
Sliding windows
Discuss sliding configurations for openings where an outward or inward sash would obstruct the space.
planning: Share the room type, opening dimensions, orientation and noise concerns. We can discuss Koemmerling profile options, compatible hardware and glazing for your home.
faq: Can I choose different glazing?
Glazing should be selected alongside the frame system. Ask about compatible options and the performance of the complete installed window.
Do uPVC windows need painting?
Routine care generally involves gentle cleaning rather than painting. Follow the chosen profile manufacturer’s maintenance instructions.

options: Fixed & opening combinations
Plan the balance between views, ventilation and access for cleaning, with profiles sized for the opening.
Finish & hardware selection
Coordinate frame finishes and handles with the building. Confirm available finishes and compatible hardware with your quotation.
planning: Share elevations, opening sizes and exposure conditions. Discuss profile selection, glass, thermal requirements and installation details before fabrication.
faq: Are aluminium windows suitable for larger openings?
Suitability depends on the selected system, span, glass and design loads. The specification must be checked for your opening.
How is thermal performance determined?
Frame construction, glazing and installation all matter. Request the performance information for the proposed system.

options: Balcony & patio access
Discuss the threshold, clear opening and available space for movement between indoors and outdoors.
Glazed door configurations
Review glazing and panel arrangements with privacy, daylight and compatible locking hardware in mind.
planning: Tell us where the door will be fitted, the opening direction, access needs and dimensions. We can help you compare suitable profile and hardware combinations.
faq: Can the door match my windows?
Discuss compatible profiles and available finishes when selecting the window and door package.
What locking options are available?
Locking hardware depends on the chosen system. Confirm the hardware and security specification in the written quotation.

intro: Aluminium doors made for the opening
options: Home & commercial access
Match the profile and hardware to how often the door will be used, its size and the required clear access.
Glazing & finish choices
Consider privacy, daylight, safety glazing and the appearance of the frame as part of the complete door specification.
planning: Share the intended use, dimensions, access requirements and finish preferences. Confirm any building-specific safety requirements with your project team.
faq: Can aluminium doors be used for shop entrances?
Discuss the expected traffic, opening size, accessibility and hardware requirements to establish a suitable system.
Are standard aluminium doors fire-rated?
A fire rating applies to a tested and certified complete assembly. Do not assume a standard aluminium door meets fire-rating requirements.

options: Window sliders
Consider sliding windows when projecting sashes would interfere with walkways, furnishings or nearby openings.
Patio & balcony sliders
Plan the number of panels, usable opening, threshold and track arrangement around everyday movement.
planning: Share the overall opening width, panel preferences and available access. Drainage, track cleaning, glazing and hardware should be considered together.
faq: How much of the opening will be clear?
The clear opening depends on the number of panels and tracks. Ask for the proposed configuration and dimensions with your quote.
How do I maintain the tracks?
Remove loose debris regularly, keep drainage openings clear and follow the hardware manufacturer’s care guidance.

options: Glazed building elevations
Discuss the intended appearance, daylight and glazing performance alongside the architectural drawings.
Project-specific detailing
Coordinate framing, fixings, drainage and interfaces with the structure and adjoining building materials.
planning: Provide elevations, structural information and project performance requirements. Facade selection requires coordination with the architect and relevant technical specialists.
faq: What information is needed for a facade enquiry?
Share elevations, approximate dimensions, location, building use and any specified glazing or performance requirements.
Can a facade be quoted from a photograph?
A photograph helps start the discussion, but detailed dimensions, technical requirements and site information are needed for a project quotation.
